purpose: Defines the shape of a Pack (domain workspace) manifest — what a domain Pack declares to APEX Core so build_workspace(pack) can render and govern it. Sibling to schema-manifest-contract.json (which governs schema/data manifests). The frame is Core; the knowledge is the Pack. See conventions/core-vs-pack-factoring.md and docs/plans/2026-07-01-apex-core-vs-domain-pack-design.md.

group.detail: left-rail grouping label — Pack taxonomy (e.g. Pricing/Markdown/Assortment), not Core structure

tools.detail: tool_registration names this agent may call

prompt_ref.detail: pointer to Pack-owned reasoning content; Core never inlines domain prompts

view.detail: gold_<domain>_v<N> — the provenance surface Core renders as a chip

schema_code.detail: L2 schema this view derives from (schema-manifest-contract.json)

target.detail: target value or predicate the strip styles against

band.detail: good/warn/critical thresholds — Pack config; Core renders the styling

threshold.detail: floor/ceiling VALUE — Pack config; the breach→escalate MECHANISM is Core

escalate_to_role.detail: named human role the escalation engine routes the sign-off to

name.detail: one-tool-one-purpose write-side MCP tool, registered into Core's tool registry

gold_writes.detail: gold views this tool may write via the run

core_provides.detail: Core-owned contracts a Pack CONFORMS to but does NOT declare — rendered and enforced by build_workspace(pack). Listed here so the seam is legible from both sides; a Pack manifest never redefines these.

recommendation_envelope.detail: The card contract → the gate-16 HITL queue → the decision written to the ledger. The workspace spine; nothing in it is domain-specific.

impact_estimate.detail: Typed synthetic-impact field so every Pack quantifies consistently and stays guardrail-compliant.

illustrative.detail: synthetic-figures-only guardrail — MUST be true; never a client claim

core_provides.escalation_engine: policy breach → block the auto-path → escalate to escalate_to_role → sign-off → write to ledger. Mechanism is Core; threshold values are Pack config.
core_provides.shell: build_workspace(pack) — composes rail + KPI strip + gate queue + agent-detail panel from this manifest; the enterprise sibling of agentic-home build_app(domains=[...]).
